purpose: Source-authored contracts for Fortress status-context predicates. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.

requiredRuntimeSemantics: attacker has exact negative live status
outgoing committed damage by that attacker
forbiddenSubstitutes: status taxonomy classification counted as live debuffed attacker
target debuff counted as attacker debuff
any buff or positive status counted as debuffed attacker
damage event counted without attacker status query proof
status SID substring or localized text counted as debuff
Fortress faction membership counted as debuffed attacker
RequiresDebuffedAttacker.notes: Hidebound Drill requires a live negative-status query on the attacker before reducing outgoing committed damage. Static taxonomy only defines eligible negative status IDs; runtime must prove attacker identity, status state, damage ordering, and owner correlation.

requiredRuntimeSemantics: enemy army has exact poison status
enemy army has exact slow or movement-restriction status
enemy army has proven mire terrain/state
forbiddenSubstitutes: status taxonomy classification counted as live enemy slow poison mire state
friendly slow or poison status counted as enemy army state
generic negative status counted as slow poison or mire
mire inferred from swamp flavor text or law name
spell cooldown row counted without enemy state proof
status SID substring or localized text counted as enemy state
RequiresEnemySlowPoisonMireState.notes: Bog Hex requires a live enemy army state: poison, slow/movement restriction, or separately proven mire. Static taxonomy covers poison/slow/movement-restriction only; mire, enemy-side correlation, cooldown ordering, and idempotence remain runtime-gated.

requiredRuntimeProof: live attacker negative status query proof
enemy side versus law-owner side proof
live enemy poison status query proof
live enemy slow or movement-restriction status query proof
cooldown mutation or penalty ordering proof
idempotent per-hit or per-cooldown application proof
